headline: MOGUL v11.1 — follower explosion fix
summary: Fixes the 10^23 followers / $7.5T-per-ad bug. Followers now cap at 2B and scale by sqrt() everywhere. Existing saves with astronomical follower counts are clamped on load.
features: Fix: follower count capped at 2 billion (was unbounded → 10^23)
Fix: likes now scale by sqrt(followers) not linear (prevents exponential growth)
Fix: socialIncome / sponsored gig pay scale by sqrt(followers)
Fix: migrate() clamps existing saves with >2B followers
Version bumped to v11.1 on homepage + version.json
